name: Conventions: triage seeded candidates (accept/reject/edit), reload, create a skill from the accepted ones
description: Deterministic (no model call) walk through the Conventions feature on the seeded demo repo acme/payments-api. The demo repo has no clone, so this flow triages the 4 candidates seed.ts pre-inserts rather than running a real scan: accepts 2, rejects 1, edits 1 inline (its rule text), leaves and comes back (client-side nav) to confirm the rejected one stays gone, then opens Create skill, edits the generated body, saves, and confirms the new skill is on /skills. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml) where the demo repo's 4 seeded conventions are still untouched and no skill named 'repo-conventions' exists yet.
